---
description: "Prepare an audience briefing"
---

Use brief to assemble current context, notes, and work. Use audience personal when the user prepares for themselves (their linked private notes are included) and audience team for anything shared. Cite sources, distinguish proposals, label Jira fetch times, and respect private scope. Return the briefing in conversation; save a dated snapshot only when requested. Sending it requires explicit user authority.

Read `.ddt/runtime/ASSISTANT.md` and `.ddt/runtime/WORKFLOWS.md`. Use its shared helper and revision/privacy rules. These commands are convenience entry points; the user can express the same intent naturally.
